Keto Starter/Rebuilder Program

  • Full nutrition assessment
  • Ketogenic diet instruction:
    • Meal planning and schedule
    • KetoDietCalculator access and training or modified keto training
    • Gram scale and keto meter training
    • Supplement recommendations
  • Total of ten video calls
  • Laboratory review and recommendations
  • Close communication with dietitian throughout program (via email/chat)
  • Program length: 120 days max
  • Investment: $2125 USD (payable in 1 or 4 installments)
